expansion_notes: HSP70 family (88 genes vs 17 in human) and inhibitor-of-apoptosis family (48 genes) expanded; Zhang et al. 2012
notes: DNMT1 and DNMT3 characterised by Riviere et al. 2013; TET presence not yet curated. Global CpG methylation ~15% from gill MBD/BS data (Gavery & Roberts 2013). Repeat fraction and high polymorphism from the 2012 genome paper; accession is the 2021 Roslin chromosome-level assembly.

Assembly C_virginica-3.0 (NCBI); no genome paper DOI curated. ~22% of CpGs methylated in gonad WGBS (Venkataraman et al. 2020). Methylation machinery, gene family expansion, repeat content and heterozygosity not yet curated from the assembly.

expansion_notes: Genome paper reports expansion of gene families associated with stress and immune response; Powell et al. 2018
notes: Which specific families were expanded should be re-checked against the full text before citing.

Genome paper (Yan et al. 2019) exists but size, repeat content, and gene-family results not yet curated. Infaunal in intertidal and shallow estuarine sediments. Accession is the 2024 chromosome-level xbRudPhil6.1 assembly (no NCBI annotation); the 2019 genome paper's assembly is not the one used for computed features.

expansion_notes: Open pan-genome with massive gene presence-absence variation, concentrated in immune and stress-related genes; Gerdol et al. 2020. Recorded here as heterozygosity, not as family expansion.

sources: Roberts Lab PGEN-v1.0 assembly, NCBI GCA_902825435.1
notes: Roberts Lab priority species. Deep-burrowing, long-lived, subtidal; matures at roughly 3-5 years. Lab WGBS exists but no methylation values curated here yet.

Roberts Lab priority species. Larviparous: fertilisation and early brooding in the mantle cavity, then a planktonic veliger stage. Gene-body methylation and its coupling to population structure from Silliman et al. 2023. Draft genome is a lab assembly; add accession when public. Accession is the 2026 PO2457 scaffold-level assembly on NCBI (no annotation there).

expansion_notes: Genome paper reports bivalve-specific gene family expansions (Takeuchi et al. 2016); which are stress- or immune-related has not been curated, so expansion is left not reported.
notes: Accession is the 2022 chromosome-level Pfu_4.1A haplotype assembly (no NCBI annotation; gene models are hosted by OIST).
Gene body methylation and its association with acclimatisation characterised by Dixon et al. 2018. Symbionts acquired horizontally each generation.
One of the eighteen Acropora genomes in Shinzato et al. 2020; genome-level features not yet curated. Accession is the 2024 chromosome-level jaAcrHyac4.1 assembly (no NCBI annotation).

expansion_notes: Innate immune gene families expanded relative to other cnidarians; Cunning et al. 2018
notes: Brooding is the dominant reproductive mode; some populations also broadcast spawn. Brooded larvae inherit symbionts from the parent.

Gene body methylation and its response to pH characterised by Liew et al. 2018; that paper also discusses the methylation machinery, from which DNMT/TET presence should be curated. Accession is the RefSeq-annotated 2017 assembly, chosen for its public proteome; a 2026 chromosome-level assembly (GCA_059055775.1) exists.

Vertical (maternal) symbiont transmission: eggs carry Symbiodiniaceae, so the parental symbiont state is heritable in this species. Size from the 2019 draft; the 2022 GigaScience assembly is chromosome-level. Accession is the 2023 chromosome-level jaMonCapi2.1 assembly (no NCBI annotation); size updated from the 2019 draft's 886 Mb to this assembly.

Salt-marsh pool anemone exposed to large temperature and salinity swings; aposymbiotic. Methylation machinery and gene-body methylation from the Zemach et al. 2010 comparative methylomes; chromosome-level assembly from Zimmermann et al. 2023.
Reproduces asexually by pedal laceration and sexually by broadcast spawning; can be maintained aposymbiotic, which is why it is the model for coral symbiosis.

Highly repetitive genome; simple sequence repeats alone make up roughly a quarter of the assembly (Zhang et al. 2019), but a total repeat fraction has not been curated. Juveniles use estuaries; adults spawn offshore.

Congener T. californicus has lost DNMT1 and DNMT3 and lacks detectable cytosine methylation (Barreto et al. 2018). Deliberately NOT carried over to this row: curate from the T. japonicus genome directly. Splash-pool habitat with extreme temperature and salinity swings; generation time about three weeks; females carry egg sacs. A T. japonicus genome exists but no assembly source has been curated here yet. Accession is the 2020 chromosome-level ASM1064515v1 assembly (no NCBI annotation).

Included as a comparator; not in the atlas. CORRECTION 2026-09-17: the first draft coded DNMT1/DNMT3 Absent and methylation Low/absent citing Barreto et al. 2018; that paper does not state this (it is a mitonuclear coevolution genome paper), and the phase-2 proteome scan finds two canonical DNMT1 genes (RFD+BAH+methylase) and no DNMT3. Curated values were withdrawn; computed values stand in.

expansion_notes: Innate immune receptor families greatly expanded: 222 Toll-like receptors, 203 NOD-like receptors, 218 SRCR genes; Sea Urchin Genome Sequencing Consortium 2006
notes: Spur_5.0 is scaffold-level on NCBI. Echinoderm mosaic methylation is textbook, but no S. purpuratus WGBS source has been curated here, so the pattern is left not reported. Ranges from the low intertidal to ~90 m.

Marlétaz et al. 2023 chromosome-level assembly; genomic features not yet curated beyond size. Accession is the 2026 chromosome-level eeParLivi1.1 assembly (no NCBI annotation); the Marletaz et al. 2023 Pliv_v1 assembly (GCA_940671915.1, 927 Mb) is registered as scaffold-level on NCBI.
No public reference genome curated. Egg masses are tended by parents; no planktonic larval phase; generation time about one month. Lives in eutrophic, organically enriched harbour sediments.

Larvae brooded in ovicells and released as short-lived non-feeding larvae. Hosts the bacterial symbiont Endobugula sertula (source of bryostatins); not an algal photosymbiosis, so symbiosis is coded None. Accession is the 2024 chromosome-level tzBugNeri2.1 assembly (no NCBI annotation); the 2020 GIGA-annotated contig assembly is GCA_010799875.2.
